topic: Light, Shadows, Reflection, and Transparent/Translucent Materials
key_concepts: A shadow forms when an object blocks light.
The position of a light source affects a shadow's size, shape, and location.
A shadow appears on the side opposite the light source.
Moving the light source changes the shadow of an object.
Light travels in a straight path until it hits a surface.
Shiny objects like mirrors reflect light.
A mirror changes the direction of light.
Transparent materials allow most light to pass through.
Translucent materials allow some light to pass through but scatter it.
Clear plastic is transparent and wax paper is translucent.
Transparent materials allow more light through than translucent materials.
